title: Canonical model maps complete the exact derived tensor row
statement: Given the three model maps induced by universal counit-compatible derived-functor transformations and their ordinary cohomology equations, there is an A tensor_R B-linear boundary map completing them to an exact five-term row, with its restriction equal to the derived homology connecting map.

proof.text: Identify all models with one universal derived extension. Apply the long exact homology sequence to the restricted distinguished triangle. Tensor induction extends the connecting map from B-linearity and A-scalar naturality to A tensor_R B-linearity, and faithful restriction reflects exactness.
